answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 of 0.088 falls in the fine-tuned range (0.086-0.092), below the quantized (0.096-0.105) and system-prompted (0.113-0.133) ranges. The mid-layer size ratio of 1.017 means the internal state grows, which matches fine-tuned (1.017-1.023). Quantized and system-prompted both shrink it (0.968 and 0.976-0.981). Direction consistency of 0.625 fits fine-tuned (0.618-0.705), while quantized is about 0.513. Layer 32 L2 of 0.291 and cosine of 0.954 are both in the fine-tuned range. The onset layer of 3 is also within the fine-tuned range (3-14). The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is tiny, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64). Effective rank of 3.72 is a bit above the fine-tuned range (2.89-3.58) and is the only slightly off value. Quantized is ruled out by the growing size ratio, the low direction consistency it would show, and the missing plateau from layer 8 to 24. No exact zeros appear, so base is ruled out.
